requirement_vague: Item creation should reject title longer than 255 characters. Test with exactly 256 characters.
requirement_precise: Register a new user via POST /api/v1/users/signup with email 'test54@example.com' and password 'validpass123'. Login to get token. Attempt to create item via POST /api/v1/items/ with title of exactly 256 characters (256 'a' characters) and description 'Test description'. Verify the response status is 422 (validation error).

implementation.reasoning: The item creation request model enforces that title length must be between 1 and 255 characters, so a title of exactly 256 characters is rejected during request validation. In FastAPI, Pydantic validation errors on the request body produce a 422 Unprocessable Entity response before create_item executes.
